data.title: Deutschlandticket Subscription Confirmation – MVB
data.summary: Musterstadt Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (MVB) confirms Sam Rivera's Deutschlandticket subscription (Handyticket) starting 01.01.2026 at 63.00 € per month, paid by SEPA direct debit at the start of each month, running for an indefinite term with monthly cancellation.
data.explanation: This letter is an order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) for your Deutschlandticket subscription, not a bill needing action right now. The ticket becomes valid on 01.01.2026 and 63.00 € will be collected from your account by direct debit every month. The subscription has no fixed end date and can be cancelled monthly, but a cancellation must reach MVB by the 10th of a month to end that same month. If the nationwide ticket price changes, MVB will notify you at least six weeks in advance and you may then cancel at the point the new price takes effect. Keep this confirmation for your records; no reply is required unless you want to change or cancel the subscription.
data.tax_note: If this Deutschlandticket is used for commuting to work, the monthly cost may be deductible as work-related travel expenses (Werbungskosten/Entfernungspauschale) in the tax return; keep the payment records.
